title: Und alle Schiffe brücken.
html_source: Stephen apparently is trying to reverse translate from Jeep’s song, and intends to sing “which brings the ship into misfortune,” but his choice of German means “And all ships are bridged.”

anchor.prefix: ains, divided by the upright, and, stepping over a strand of mire, went across towards Gardiner street lower, Stephen singing more boldly, but not loudly, the end of the ballad.
